req.title: Set cookie via path
req.statement: The system shall set a cookie of name=<name>, value=<value> and redirect to /cookies when GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> sets a cookie and issues a 302 redirect to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) positive path — correct 302 status, Set-Cookie header with exact name/value, Location header pointing to /cookies; (2) negative path — missing path segments yield 404; (3) boundary — single-character name/value, empty-string-like minimal inputs, and special characters. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (302 not 301/303), exact Location header value, exact cookie name and value in Set-Cookie header, and verifying the redirect target is precisely /cookies.

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_standard_name_value
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create Flask test client with allow_redirects=False
trace: R-HTTPBIN-030: Set-Cookie header issued with name=testname, value=testvalue
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_standard_name_value():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/testname/testvalue', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies'
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'testname=testvalue' in set_cookie

test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_standard_name_value()

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_redirect_target_is_exactly_cookies():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/mykey/myval', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies'
    assert location != '/cookies/set'

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_negative_missing_both_segments
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: GET /cookies/set (no name or value path segments)
expected: HTTP 200 status code (routes to set_cookies query-string handler, not set_cookie path handler)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-030: /cookies/set without path params routes to different handler
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_negative_missing_both_segments():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set', follow_redirects=False)
    # /cookies/set with no query params redirects to /cookies (302)
    # This is the set_cookies handler, not set_cookie handler
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies'
    # No Set-Cookie header should be present (no cookies to set)
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert set_cookie == ''

test_set_cookie_via_path_negative_missing_both_segments()

import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_followed_redirect_shows_cookie():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/session/abc123', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert 'cookies' in data

import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_value_not_swapped_with_name():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/cookiename/cookievalue', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'cookiename' in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies']['cookiename'] == 'cookievalue'
    assert 'cookievalue' not in data['cookies']
